replies.author: vvs_nq
replies.body:
i wouldnt recommend trading view. its pretty mid and there are better platforms with also realtime charts and 1 sec timeframe.  
and first of all nobody can tell you if anything is worth it or not. only you can by testing it out yourself.   
you dont need anything for this bot. only metatrader5 and the bot file which is basically just a code that waits for specific calculations to enter a trade then. i did this to automate my trading strategy which was for futures only. but cfd move the same so i built it for mt5 so i can test in on demo and now i can trade both futures and cfds. and in theory also options because it uses options data first before converting it to cfd/futures prices

comments.author: LouZEverything
comments.body:
Congrats on getting the bot through an eval.  
That said, I have a genuine question. If the strategy has been consistently profitable for months and the bot can now pass funded evaluations, why are you selling signals instead of just scaling the strategy yourself? Also, it would be more transparent to mention up front that this post is promoting a signal service. Framing it as a success story without disclosing the commercial angle feels a bit like clickbait. If the strategy is as good as you’re implying, I’d be much more interested in hearing about things like execution, risk management, slippage, and the challenges of automating it than being funneled toward a paid service.
